_help: Curated reading labels shown above a card's claims of a given kind, when the raw claim wording alone could mislead (decided from QA). Format: {"<slug>": {"<claim kind>": "label text"}}. These replace the automatic 'QA caution' label for that kind.

termix-aacp.economic_flow: Gross on-chain volume, about 99% circular (wallets cycling funds between each other) per an independent decode (ChainWard); not organic demand.
termix-aacp.metric: The 'agents' figure counts a shared ERC-8004 registry used by all ERC-8004 agents, not TermiX users; jobs are mostly circular. About 19,900 wallets ever settled a job (ChainWard, to 2026-09-29).
